Mp00224.description: The word obtained by sorting the weakly increasing runs lexicographically.

Mp00225.title: weight
Mp00225.description: The weight of a semistandard tableau as an integer partition.

Mp00226.title: row-to-column-descents
Mp00226.description: Return a standard tableau whose column descent set equals the row descent set of the original tableau.

Mp00227.title: Delest-Viennot-inverse
Mp00227.description: Return the Dyck path obtained by applying the inverse of Delest-Viennot's bijection to the corresponding parallelogram polyomino.

Mp00228.title: reflect parallelogram polyomino
Mp00228.description: Reflect the corresponding parallelogram polyomino, such that the first column becomes the first row.

Mp00229.title: Delest-Viennot
Mp00229.description: Return the Dyck path corresponding to the parallelogram polyomino obtained by applying Delest-Viennot's bijection.

Mp00230.title: parallelogram polyomino
Mp00230.description: Return the Dyck path corresponding to the partition interpreted as a parallogram polyomino.

Mp00231.title: bounce path
Mp00231.description: The bounce path determined by an integer composition.

Mp00232.title: parallelogram poset
Mp00232.description: The cell poset of the parallelogram polyomino corresponding to the Dyck path.

Mp00233.title: skew partition
Mp00233.description: The parallelogram polyomino corresponding to a Dyck path, interpreted as a skew partition.

Mp00234.title: valleys-to-peaks
Mp00234.description: Return the binary word with every valley replaced by a peak.

Mp00235.title: descent views to invisible inversion bottoms
Mp00235.description: Return a permutation whose multiset of invisible inversion bottoms is the multiset of descent views of the given permutation.

Mp00236.title: Clarke-Steingrimsson-Zeng inverse
Mp00236.description: The inverse of the Clarke-Steingrimsson-Zeng map, sending excedances to descents.

Mp00237.title: descent views to invisible inversion bottoms
Mp00237.description: Return a permutation whose multiset of invisible inversion bottoms is the multiset of descent views of the given permutation.

Mp00238.title: Clarke-Steingrimsson-Zeng
Mp00238.description: The Clarke-Steingrimsson-Zeng map sending descents to excedances.

Mp00239.title: Corteel
Mp00239.description: Corteel's map interchanging the number of crossings and the number of nestings of a permutation.

Mp00240.title: weak exceedance partition
Mp00240.description: The set partition induced by the weak exceedances of a permutation.

Mp00241.title: invert Laguerre heap
Mp00241.description: The permutation obtained by inverting the corresponding Laguerre heap, according to Viennot.

Mp00242.title: Hessenberg poset
Mp00242.description: The Hessenberg poset of a Dyck path.

Mp00243.title: weak duplicate order
Mp00243.description: The weak duplicate order of the de-duplicate of a graph.

Mp00244.title: bar
Mp00244.description: Return the signed permutation with all signs reversed.

Mp00245.title: standardize
Mp00245.description: Return the standardization of the signed permutation, where 1 is the smallest and -1 the largest element.

Mp00246.title: rotate
Mp00246.description: The rotation of an ordered tree.

Mp00248.title: DEX composition
Mp00248.description: The DEX composition of a permutation.

Mp00249.title: Callan switch
Mp00249.description: Switch the first closer and the minimum of the smallest closer and the second element of the block containing 1 in a set partition.

Mp00250.title: clique graph
Mp00250.description: The clique graph of a graph.

Mp00251.title: clique sizes
Mp00251.description: The integer partition of the sizes of the maximal cliques of a graph.

Mp00252.title: restriction
Mp00252.description: The permutation obtained by removing the largest letter.

Mp00253.title: permutation
Mp00253.description: The underlying permutation of the decorated permutation.

Mp00254.title: Inverse fireworks map
Mp00254.description: Sends a permutation to an inverse fireworks permutation.

Mp00255.title: lower permutation
Mp00255.description: The lower bound in the Grassmann interval corresponding to the decorated permutation.

Mp00256.title: upper permutation
Mp00256.description: The upper bound in the Grassmann interval corresponding to the decorated permutation.

Mp00257.title: Alexandersson Kebede
Mp00257.description: Sends a permutation to a permutation and it preserves the set of right-to-left minima.

Mp00258.title: Standard tableau associated to a set partition
Mp00258.description: Sends a set partition to the associated standard tableau.

Mp00259.title: vertex addition
Mp00259.description: Adds a disconnected vertex to a graph.

Mp00260.title: Demazure product with inverse
Mp00260.description: This map sends a permutation $\pi$ to $\pi^{-1} \star \pi$ where $\star$ denotes the Demazure product on signed permutations.

Mp00261.title: Burrows-Wheeler
Mp00261.description: The Burrows-Wheeler transform of a binary word.

Mp00262.title: poset of factors
Mp00262.description: The poset of factors of a binary word.

Mp00263.title: join irreducibles
Mp00263.description: The poset of join irreducibles of a lattice.

Mp00264.title: delete endpoints
Mp00264.description: Sends a graph to a maximal subgraph with no endpoints.

Mp00265.title: conjugation by long cycle
Mp00265.description: Sends the permutation $\pi \in \mathfrak{S}_n$ to the permutation $c^{-1}\pi c$ where $c = (1,\ldots,n)$ is the long cycle.

Mp00266.title: connected vertex partitions
Mp00266.description: Sends a graph to the lattice of its connected vertex partitions.

Mp00267.title: signs
Mp00267.description: The binary word recording the signs of a signed permutation.

Mp00268.title: zeros to flag zeros
Mp00268.description: Return a binary word of the same length, such that the number of occurrences of $10$ in the word obtained by prepending the reverse of the complement equals the number of $0$s in the original word.

Mp00269.title: flag zeros to zeros
Mp00269.description: Return a binary word of the same length, such that the number of zeros equals the number of occurrences of $10$ in the word obtained from the original word by prepending the reverse of the complement.

Mp00270.title: negatives to flag negatives
Mp00270.description: A map sending the number of negative entries to the number of flag negative entries.

Mp00271.title: flag negatives to negatives
Mp00271.description: A map sending the number of flag negative entries to the number of negative entries.

Mp00272.title: Gray next
Mp00272.description: The next element in the Gray code for binary words.

Mp00273.title: Gray previous
Mp00273.description: The previous element in the Gray code for binary words.

Mp00274.title: block-cut tree
Mp00274.description: Sends a graph to its block-cut tree.

Mp00275.title: to edge-partition of connected components
Mp00275.description: Sends a graph to the partition recording the number of edges in its connected components.

Mp00276.title: to edge-partition of biconnected components
Mp00276.description: Sends a graph to the partition recording the number of edges in its biconnected components.

Mp00278.title: rowmotion
Mp00278.description: Return the rowmotion of the binary word, regarded as an order ideal in the product of two chains.

Mp00279.title: Backward Rotation
Mp00279.description: Rotates a permutation by moving the first entry last.

Mp00280.title: path rowmotion
Mp00280.description: Return the rowmotion of the binary word, regarded as a lattice path.

Mp00281.title: rowmotion
Mp00281.description: The rowmotion of a signed permutation with respect to the sorting order.

Mp00282.title: Dedekind-MacNeille completion
Mp00282.description: Return the smallest lattice containing the poset.

Mp00283.title: non-nesting-exceedence permutation
Mp00283.description: The fixed-point-free permutation with deficiencies given by the perfect matching, no alignments and no inversions between exceedences.

Mp00284.title: rows
Mp00284.description: The set partition whose blocks are the rows of the tableau.

Mp00286.title: to permutation
Mp00286.description: Return the permutation obtained by concatenating the blocks sorted into increasing order.

Mp00287.title: to composition
Mp00287.description: Return the sizes of the blocks as a composition.

Mp00288.title: reverse
Mp00288.description: Reverse the order of the blocks of the ordered set partition.

Mp00289.title: complement
Mp00289.description: Return the ordered set partition obtained by complementing each entry.

Mp00290.title: to ordered set partition
Mp00290.description: Return the ordered set partition whose blocks are the labels of the runs of the labelled Dyck path.

Mp00291.title: rotate back to front
Mp00291.description: Return the ordered set partition obtained by moving the last block to the beginning.

Mp00292.title: rotate front to back
Mp00292.description: Return the ordered set partition obtained by moving the first block to the end.

Mp00293.title: rotate front-to-back
Mp00293.description: Rotate a parking function by moving the first entry to the last position.

Mp00294.title: peak composition
Mp00294.description: The composition corresponding to the peak set of a standard tableau.

Mp00295.title: valley composition
Mp00295.description: The composition corresponding to the valley set of a standard tableau.

Mp00296.title: Knuth-Krattenthaler
Mp00296.description: The map that sends the Dyck path to a 321-avoiding permutation, then applies the Robinson-Schensted correspondence and finally interprets the first row of the insertion tableau and the second row of the recording tableau as up steps.

Mp00297.title: ordered tree
Mp00297.description: The ordered tree associated with the parking function by Pollak.

Mp00298.title: repeats to leading
Mp00298.description: The unique parking function obtained by computing successive differences to obtain a Prüfer code, then prepending 0 and cyclically shifting.

Mp00299.title: ones to leading
Mp00299.description: The unique parking function obtained by applying the Foata-Riordan map to obtain a Prüfer code, then prepending 0 and cyclically shifting.

Mp00300.title: leading to ones
Mp00300.description: The unique parking function obtained by subtracting the first entry from all others to obtain a Prüfer code and then applying the inverse of the Foata-Riordan map.

Mp00301.title: leading to repeats
Mp00301.description: The unique parking function obtained by prepending 0 and shifting the cumulative sums of a Prüfer code, then cyclically shifting.

Mp00302.title: insertion tableau
Mp00302.description: The insertion tableau obtained by applying RSK to the parking function regarded as a word.

Mp00303.title: complement
Mp00303.description: The complement of a parking function.

Mp00304.title: rotate back-to-front
Mp00304.description: Rotate a parking function by moving the last entry to the first position.

Mp00305.title: parking function
Mp00305.description: Interpret the permutation as a parking function.

Mp00306.title: rowmotion cycle type
Mp00306.description: The cycle type of rowmotion on the order ideals of a poset.

Mp00307.title: promotion cycle type
Mp00307.description: The cycle type of promotion on the linear extensions of a poset.

Mp00311.title: to partition
Mp00311.description: The underlying integer partition of a plane partition.

Mp00312.title: Glaisher-Franklin
Mp00312.description: The Glaisher-Franklin bijection on integer partitions.

Mp00313.title: Glaisher-Franklin inverse
Mp00313.description: The Glaisher-Franklin bijection on integer partitions.

Mp00317.title: odd parts
Mp00317.description: Return the binary word indicating which parts of the partition are odd.

Mp00318.title: dual on components
Mp00318.description: The dual of the 3-connected planar components of a graph.

Mp00319.title: to composition
Mp00319.description: Return the parking function interpreted as an integer composition.

Mp00320.title: reverse
Mp00320.description: Return the reversal of a parking function.

Mp00321.title: 2-conjugate
Mp00321.description: Return a partition with the same number of odd parts and number of even parts interchanged with the number of cells with zero leg and odd arm length.

Mp00322.title: Loehr-Warrington
Mp00322.description: Return a partition whose diagonal inversion number is the length of the preimage.

Mp00323.title: Loehr-Warrington inverse
Mp00323.description: Return a partition whose length is the diagonal inversion number of the preimage.

Mp00324.title: chromatic difference sequence
Mp00324.description: The chromatic difference sequence of a graph.

Mp00325.title: ones to leading
Mp00325.description: The unique permutation obtained by applying the Foata-Riordan map to obtain a Prüfer code, then prepending zero and cyclically shifting.

Mp00326.title: weak order rowmotion
Mp00326.description: Return the reversal of the permutation obtained by inverting the corresponding Laguerre heap.

Mp00327.title: inverse Kreweras complement
Mp00327.description: Return the inverse of the Kreweras complement of a Dyck path, regarded as a noncrossing set partition.

Mp00328.title: DeBruijn-Morselt plane tree automorphism
Mp00328.description: This automorphism on the set of plane trees with a given number of vertices is the combination of the two "canonical" bijections between plane trees and binary trees, using either the left or right branches. Mp00329.title: Tanimoto
Mp00329.description: Add 1 to every entry of the permutation (n becomes 1 instead of n+1), except that when n appears at the front or the back of the permutation, instead remove it and place 1 at the other end of the permutation.

Mp00332.title: Jordan block partition
Mp00332.description: The partition given by the sizes of the Jordan blocks of the zeta matrix.

Mp00333.title: link pattern
Mp00333.description: The Dyck path corresponding to the link pattern of the alternating sign matrix interpreted as a fully packed loop configuration.

Mp00334.title: diagonal height
Mp00334.description: The Dyck path obtained by interpreting the diagonal and off-diagonal entries of the height function of the alternating sign matrix as a sequence of heights.

Mp00335.title: zero-divisor graph
Mp00335.description: The zero divisor graph of a lattice.

Mp00336.title: standard permutation
Mp00336.description: Return the standardization of a binary word.
